LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Mag. c.]
Restlessness in legs.
Drawing pains in legs and feet.
Itching of buttocks, with red spots after scratching.
Pains around left knee, like something tight ; left calf hard ; hard swelling in hollow of knee ; cannot put left foot to ground when walking, but only when standing. θ Affection of knee.
Painful swelling in bend of knee.
Knees painful in walking, feet when lying in bed.
Cramp in calves (at night).
Burning spot on tibia.
Œdema of feet up to calves.
Blood-boils on lower legs.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Mag. c.]
Rheumatic pains in limbs.
Restlessness in limbs, in evening after sitting long.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Mag. c.]
Rest : during, pain in malar bone insupportable ; pains insupportable.
Lying down : pain in left hypochondriac region < ; external coldness.
Lying in bed : feet painful.
Must support back with hands and get up and walk about ; pain in left hypochondriac region.
Head thrown back, or leg drawn up, left leg perfectly straight.
Sitting : smarting leucorrhœa ; restlessness in limbs ; sensation of being tired.
Kneeling : vertigo.
Standing : vertigo ; frequent sudden falling, with consciousness ; epileptic attacks.
Rising from seat : involuntary urination.
Can scarcely raise right arm : pain in shoulder.
Least movement impossible : pain from shoulder to fingers.
Motion : of shoulder joint, pain as from dislocation.
After a walk : heaviness and dizziness of head >.
Walking : frequent sudden falling, with consciousness ; pains < ; prickings in rectum ; involuntary urination ; smarting leucorrhœa ; cannot put left foot to ground ; knees painful ; tires much.
Must walk floor : neuralgia facial.
Driving from one place to another : tearing pain in malar bone.
Obliged to run from room to room and wag head all night on account of pain in face.
   

NERVES. [36] [Mag. c.]
Pains : neuralgic, lightning-like, < left side ; insupportable during repose, must get up and walk about.
Spasms.
Epileptic attacks ; while standing or walking, he frequently falls down suddenly, with consciousness.
Head thrown back, or leg drawn up, left leg perfectly straight ; seems sore and cries about being moved ; lumbar vertebræ sensitive to touch ; has no power over left leg and but little strength in left hand ; will eat nothing but meat, nor drink anything but soup made of meat ; stools large, crumbling, infrequent. θ Nervous affection.
Sensation of being tired, especially in feet and when sitting ; aching, restless.
A short walk tires much.
Flaccidity, laxness of body.
Disposed to neuralgia.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Mag. c.]
Sleepiness during day.
Sleeplessness, from nightly oppression in abdomen.
Restless sleep with frequent waking.
Unrefreshing sleep, more tired in morning than when lying down in evening.
Awakes about 2 to 3 A. M., and cannot fall asleep again.
Dreams : anxious, with starts and crying out in sleep ; of dead persons ; of fire ; of thieves.
   

TIME. [38] [Mag. c.]
From 2 to 3 A. M. : awakes and cannot fall asleep again.
At 4 A. M. : woke with intolerable pain in rectum.
Morning : after rising, vertigo ; heaviness and dizziness in head ; lancinating headache ; agglutination of lids ; bleeding from nose ; dryness of mouth ; frequent rising of mucus in throat.
Morning : on rising, contractive pain in abdomen ; sputum yellow, thin, or tough mucus, or dark blood ; more tired than in evening.
Day : menstrual flow less ; sputum yellow, thin or tough mucus, or dark blood ; sleepiness.
All day : anxious, with perspiration ; trembling, anguish, fear ; toothache slight ; fine cutting in abdomen.
Afternoon : toothache begins ; menses stop ; smarting leucorrhœa ; heat <.
Evening : vertigo, as if about to faint ; toothache commences ; thirst for water ; cough < until after midnight ; restlessness in limbs after sitting long ; external coldness.
From 1 to 10 P. M. : violent, darting headache.
Night : wakened by obstruction of nose ; toothache < ; increase of saliva < ; dryness of mouth ; thirst for water ; pain in left hypochondriac region ; menses flow more ; spasmodic cough ; pain in back and small of back ; rheumatic pain in shoulders ; cramps in calves.
At 12 P. M. till morning : sweat, with thirst.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Mag. c.]
Eating warm food : anxious and warm through whole body.
Warmth of bed : toothache <.
Going to bed : > anxiety.
Great aversion to uncovering.
Wet and rainy weather : itching of scalp.
Change of temperature : neuralgia facial <.
Draft : neuralgia facial <.
Cold water : > toothache for a short time ; toothache <.
Cold : toothache.
   

FEVER. [40] [Mag. c.]
Chill and chilliness : with external coldness in evening and after lying down, slowly going off, followed by heat ; in bed as if dashed with cold water ; great aversion to uncovering.
Chill : running down back ; > by out door exercise.
Great internal heat, at night, restless, aversion to uncovering.
Heat : one (r.) sided ; mostly in forenoon, often with sweat on head.
Redness, burning and thirst for half an hour, often with sweat on head.
Sweat : greasy, oily, stains yellow ; difficult to wash off ; sour, putrid smelling.
Sweat, with thirst, after 12 P. M. till morning.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Mag. c.]
Seven or eight times a day for eight days : diarrhœa and colic.
Nightly : tearing, digging and boring in malar bone ; oppression in abdomen.
Every second day : stool.
For one week : sleeplessness.
Every three weeks : green watery diarrhœa ; all symptoms <.
All the symptoms aggravated every third week.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Mag. c.]
Right : hard nodosity on temple ; bleeding from nose < right side ; whizzing, buzzing, fluttering in ear ; severe boring in side of lower jaw ; tearing pain in side of face ; several hollow teeth on side ; tooth ache in upper and lower jaw ; much pain in shoulder ; lameness of arm ; heat on side.
Left : neuralgia facial ; pain from teeth to temple ; insupportable pain in hypochondriac region ; affection of abdominal ring ; stitches in side under short ribs ; pains around knee ; calf hard ; cannot put foot to ground ; neuralgic pains < on side ; has no power over leg and but little strength in hand.
From without inward : stitch in precordial region.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Mag. c.]
As if everything was turning around ; as if about to faint ; as if hair was pulled ; as if white of egg had dried on face ; teeth as if too long ; throat as if scraped by an awn ; as if menses would come on ; particles of diarrhœa look as if chopped up ; as if rectum was pierced with needles ; back as if broken ; as if spine was bent back ; shoulder as if dislocated ; as of something tight around knee ; as if dashed with cold water.
Pain : on top of head ; in face ; over umbilicus ; in back ; in small of back ; in shoulder joint ; in shoulder ; around l. knee.
Much pain : in head and right shoulder.
Intolerable pain : in rectum.
Insupportable pain : in left hypochondriac region, through to back.
Insupportable tearing pain : generally from a hollow tooth, through face into head and eye.
Violent pain : in abdomen.
Violent, darting pain : in head.
Lightning-like shooting : in left side of face.
Lancinating : in head.
Cutting : about navel ; in abdomen.
Pinching, griping : in abdomen.
Tearing, digging and boring : in malar bones.
Violent, concussive, tearing, stitching pain : in coccygeal region.
Burning, tearing, drawing, twitching or great ulcerative pain : in teeth.
Burning, throbbing pains : in malar bone and ear.
Beating : in teeth.
Pulsating pain : in malar bones.
Spasmodic pain : in abdomen.
Ulcerative pain : in stomach.
Stitches : in anus ; in rectum ; in left side under short ribs ; in chest and region of heart.
Stitch : in precordial region.
Pressing, spasmodic, contractive, colicky pains : in abdomen.
Cramp : in calves.
Constrictive pain : in stomach.
Aching and contractive pain : in stomach.
Labor-like pains : before menses.
Dragging pain : in abdomen.
Drawing pain : in sides ; in legs and feet.
Rheumatic pain : in shoulders ; in limbs.
Pressive pain : in forehead ; in nose.
Sticking : in head.
Burning : of eyes ; in all teeth on right side ; in throat and palate ; at anus ; in spot on tibia.
Burning, smarting : during urination.
Stinging : of eyes ; in teeth ; in throat.
Great soreness : in ears.
Soreness : of throat ; in chest and region of heart.
Bruised sensation : of vertex.
Heat : in head and hands.
Pulsating : in forehead.
Throbbing with stitches : in teeth.
Twitching : in fingers.
Hardness with stitches : in hepatic region.
Drawing out sensation : in ear.
Pressure : in forehead ; in eyes ; towards pelvis.
Tension : on face.
Constriction : of chest.
Emptiness and qualmishness : in stomach.
Anxious feeling : in whole body, especially in head.
Dulness : of head.
Heaviness : in head ; in abdomen.
Oppression : of chest.
Dizziness : in head.
Dryness : of eyes ; of mouth ; of throat ; of fauces.
Hot sensation : in mouth.
Prickings : in rectum.
Stiffness : of muscles of neck and throat.
Ringing : in ears.
Whizzing, buzzing, fluttering : in ear.
Tired sensation : in feet.
Lameness : of right arm.
Restlessness : in limbs.
Tickling : in larynx.
Tingling : down to fingers.
Violent itching : over whole body.
Itching : of scalp ; of pudendum ; of buttocks.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Mag. c.]
Weakened condition of muscular structures ; flaccidity ; laxness ; hernia.
Rheumatic affection of groups of muscles and of joints.
Engorged glands ; scrofulosis.
Spasmodic affections of stomach and intestines, increased secretion from mucous membranes, and glands of stomach and intestines.
Defective digestion ; emaciation, swelling of glands, abdomen heavy and bloated. θ Atrophy of children.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Mag. c.]
Touch : neuralgia facial < ; teeth extremely sensitive ; temple sensitive ; causes ulcerative pain in teeth ; causes bleeding of vesicles on gums, cheeks, tongue, lips and palate ; cannot bear it when at stool ; lumbar vertebræ sensitive.
Hold painful side of face : obliged to.
Pressure : stomach very sensitive : over umbilicus causes pain ; on abdomen menstrual flow > ; on tubercle on wrist causes pouring out of water from it.
Scratching : causes red spots on buttocks ; lessens itching of skin.
Riding in a carriage : toothache ; nausea.
   

SKIN. [46] [Mag. c.]
Sour smell of whole body.
Violent itching over whole body.
Itching and dryness of skin ; itching > by scratching.
Large stinging nodosities under skin.
Painful, small, red herpes, scaling off.
Spreading blisters.
Small blood-boils (lower legs) with headache and yellow tongue.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Mag. c.]
Adapted to persons, especially children, of irritable disposition, nervous temperament ; lax fibre ; sour smell.
Child, æt. 16 mos., suffering three weeks ; diarrhœa.
Boy, æt. 4 ; ascarides.
Boy, æt. 8, dark complexion, large head and very small limbs ; nervous affection.
Girl, æt. 11 ; scrofulous inflammation of eyes.
Girl, æt. 22 ; toothache.
Woman, æt. 24, blonde, sanguine temperament, excitable ; toothache.
Young woman, suffering four months ; affection of knee.
Woman, æt. 27, fair and stout, married six years, but never pregnant, menstruation normal before marriage, irregular soon after, appearing at intervals of three or four months, and continuing for twelve to sixteen weeks ; menorrhagia.
Man, æt. 32, good health, father had been operated for cataract on both eyes ; lenticular cataract.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Mag. c.]
Antidoted by : Arsen., Chamom., (neuralgia) ; Merc. sol., Nux vom., Pulsat., Rheum (abdominal troubles).
It antidotes : Acet. acid.
Compatible : Caustic., Phosphor., Pulsat., Sepia, Sulphur.
Complementary : Chamom.
Compare : Aloes., Ant. crud. (headache from smoking), Calc., Coloc. (cutting, griping, > after stool), Graphit., Ipec. (nausea and grass green stools), Lycop., Nitr. ac., Nux mosch., Silica.
